$comment: Link to the org's architectural repo of record (the SpecDev governance repo). Filled by /specdev:init. All org-ADR tooling (check_org_adrs.py, org-adr-check.yml, the adr-checker agent) is inert while values are REPLACE_ME. 'classification' declares one value per axis of the governance repo's classification.json (init rewrites the keys to match the org's axes; the two below are the seeded defaults) and scopes which org ADRs bind this repo. A bare string is accepted when the org scheme defines a single axis. Pin 'ref' to a tag to upgrade governance deliberately; leave 'main' to track it.
